aboutText: Ez Mowing has been keeping Point Cook lawns neat and tidy for homeowners and businesses across the western suburbs. We take the hassle out of lawn care with regular mowing packages, one-off cut-and-cleans, and green waste removal. Based right here in Point Cook, we know the local grass types, seasonal growth patterns, and what it takes to keep your yard looking sharp all year round.
servicesText: From routine weekly mows to full yard clean-ups, Ez Mowing covers everything your outdoor space needs. We service Point Cook and surrounding suburbs with flexible booking and no-contract options.

services.desc: Scheduled weekly, fortnightly or monthly mowing to keep your Point Cook lawn at the perfect height year-round.
